entries.summaryZh: 1877年9月24日，日本西南战争的最后一战在鹿儿岛城山展开。西乡隆盛率残余萨摩藩士据守城山，遭山县有朋指挥的政府军包围。政府军以炮击与优势兵力发起总攻，萨军抵抗数小时后被歼灭，西乡隆盛阵亡。武士阶级主导的叛乱至此终结。
entries.summaryEn: On 24 September 1877 the last battle of the Satsuma Rebellion was fought at Shiroyama in Kagoshima. Saigo Takamori's remaining samurai, besieged by government troops under Yamagata Aritomo, were attacked with artillery and overwhelming numbers and destroyed within hours; Saigo died. Armed resistance by the samurai class ended.
entries.significanceZh: 城山之战终结了西南战争，也标志着明治政府完成对武士阶层武装反抗的镇压。
entries.significanceEn: Shiroyama ended the Satsuma Rebellion and completed the Meiji government's suppression of samurai armed resistance.
entries.notesZh: 西乡隆盛的死因有战死、自尽与介错诸说，萨军参战人数亦无确切记载；本条只保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: Saigo's death is variously described as killed in action or ritual suicide, and the number of defenders is not securely recorded; this entry keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 1939年9月至10月，日军第11军从赣北、鄂南、湘北三个方向进攻长沙，中国第九战区部队逐次抵抗并侧击其补给线。日军在未能围歼中国军队的情况下撤回原阵地，长沙未被占领。这是欧战爆发后日军在中国战场发动的第一次大规模攻势。
entries.summaryEn: From September to October 1939 the Japanese Eleventh Army advanced on Changsha from three directions. Chinese Ninth War Area troops resisted in depth and struck at Japanese supply lines, and the Japanese withdrew without taking the city. It was Japan's first large offensive in China after the war began in Europe.
entries.significanceZh: 第一次长沙战役挫败了日军以攻迫降的企图，是抗战相持阶段中国军队少有的守住城市的战役。
entries.significanceEn: The first battle of Changsha frustrated Japan's attempt to force a settlement by attack and was a rare successful defence of a city in the stalemate phase.
entries.notesZh: 日方战报与中方记载的伤亡数字相差很大，参战兵力统计亦不一致；本条只保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: Japanese and Chinese casualty and troop figures differ widely; this entry keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 2004年11月7日至12月23日，美军、英军与伊拉克政府军发起代号幽灵怒火的攻势，攻入反美武装控制的费卢杰。美军以逐屋清剿推进，巷战激烈程度被比作顺化战役，武装人员大部被歼或溃散。城市在战斗中严重损毁，此后长期处于重建与动荡之中。
entries.summaryEn: From 7 November to 23 December 2004 US, British and Iraqi government forces launched Operation Phantom Fury against insurgent-held Fallujah. Troops cleared the city house by house in fighting compared to Hue, and most fighters were killed or dispersed. The city was severely damaged and remained unstable long afterwards.
entries.significanceZh: 费卢杰是伊拉克战争中规模最大的城市战，也暴露了占领时期政治与军事手段的深层矛盾。
entries.significanceEn: Fallujah was the largest urban operation of the Iraq War and exposed the political and military contradictions of the occupation.
entries.notesZh: 反美武装死亡人数（一千余至数千）没有可靠统计，平民伤亡亦无定论；本条只保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: Insurgent deaths, variously given as about a thousand or several thousand, have no reliable count, and civilian casualties are unsettled; this entry keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 公元383年秋，前秦君主苻坚率号称八十余万的大军南征东晋，两军在淝水（今安徽寿县一带）对峙。晋军要求秦军后撤以便渡河决战，秦军后撤时阵脚大乱，晋军趁势猛攻并大败秦军。前秦由此瓦解，北方重新分裂，境内各族势力纷纷自立，北方再度陷入分裂。
entries.summaryEn: In the autumn of 383 the Former Qin ruler Fu Jian invaded the Eastern Jin with a vastly larger army and the two forces faced each other at the Fei River in Anhui. When Qin troops stepped back to let the Jin cross, their line collapsed and the Jin counter-attacked, routing them. Former Qin broke apart and the north fragmented.
entries.significanceZh: 淝水之战保住了东晋政权，并确立了此后近两百年南北分立的格局。
entries.significanceEn: Fei River preserved the Eastern Jin state and fixed the north-south division of China for nearly two centuries.
entries.notesZh: 前秦兵力号称八十余万，现代研究普遍认为有夸大，实际参战人数难以确定；本条只保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: The claimed Qin army of over 800,000 is widely considered inflated and the real numbers cannot be established; this entry keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 1053年6月18日，欧特维尔的亨佛瑞率诺曼骑兵在意大利南部的奇维塔特击败教宗良九世组织的施瓦本、伦巴第与意大利联军。诺曼人先以一部牵制联军主力，再以重骑兵冲击并击溃对方，教宗随后被俘。此役迫使教廷承认诺曼人在南意大利的地位。
entries.summaryEn: On 18 June 1053 Humphrey of Hauteville's Norman cavalry defeated a Swabian, Lombard and Italian army raised by Pope Leo IX at Civitate in southern Italy. The Normans fixed the allied centre, broke it with a heavy cavalry charge and then took the pope prisoner. The defeat forced the papacy to accept the Norman presence in the south.
entries.significanceZh: 奇维塔特之战使诺曼征服南意大利获得教廷默许，为西西里王国的建立铺路。
entries.significanceEn: Civitate won tacit papal acceptance for the Norman conquest of southern Italy and prepared the way for the kingdom of Sicily.
entries.notesZh: 双方兵力与战场确切位置均有争议，诺曼骑兵人数常被估为三千；本条只保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: The size of both armies and the exact battlefield are disputed, with Norman horse commonly estimated at about 3,000; this entry keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 1532年11月16日，皮萨罗率不足两百名西班牙人在印加帝国北部城市卡哈马卡设伏，俘虏皇帝阿塔瓦尔帕并屠杀其随从。印加军队因皇帝被擒而失去指挥，西班牙人以赎金换取黄金白银后仍处死阿塔瓦尔帕。此役开启了西班牙征服秘鲁的进程。
entries.summaryEn: On 16 November 1532 Francisco Pizarro ambushed the Inca emperor Atahualpa at Cajamarca with fewer than two hundred Spaniards, seizing him and killing thousands of his attendants. The Inca army, leaderless, withdrew; after taking a room full of gold and silver as ransom the Spaniards executed Atahualpa. The conquest of Peru had begun.
entries.significanceZh: 卡哈马卡以极少兵力擒获印加皇帝，是美洲征服中最具决定性的伏击战之一。
entries.significanceEn: Cajamarca captured the Inca emperor with a tiny force and ranks among the most decisive ambushes of the conquest of the Americas.
entries.notesZh: 广场上被杀的随从人数在不同史料中从两千到八千不等，另有学者主张称为卡哈马卡屠杀；本条只保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: Death tolls in the plaza range from 2,000 to 8,000 in different accounts and some scholars prefer to call the event a massacre; this entry keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 1897年9月12日，英属印度锡克团第36团21名士兵驻守的萨拉加希哨所被奥拉克扎伊与阿夫里迪部落武装包围。守军在伊沙尔·辛格带领下拒绝投降，全部阵亡，哨所随后被部落武装占领。两天后英印军队夺回该地，21人获追授勋章，该哨所是当时英印军边境通信链的一环。
entries.summaryEn: On 12 September 1897 the Saragarhi outpost held by twenty-one Sikh soldiers of the 36th Sikhs of British India was surrounded by Orakzai and Afridi tribesmen. Led by Havildar Ishar Singh the garrison refused to surrender and was killed to the last man. British Indian troops retook the post two days later and all twenty-one were decorated.
entries.significanceZh: 萨拉加希成为英属印度军队与今日印度陆军的标志性战例，用于纪念军人的坚守与牺牲。
entries.significanceEn: Saragarhi became an emblematic action for the British Indian Army and for the present Indian Army, commemorated for holding to the last.
entries.notesZh: 进攻方人数（约一万至一万四千）为后世估算，守军全部阵亡前坚持的时长各说不同；本条只保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: Attacker numbers of about 10,000 to 14,000 are later estimates and the duration of the defence varies by account; this entry keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 公元708年，拜占庭皇帝查士丁尼二世率军进攻保加利亚，在安基阿卢斯（今保加利亚波摩莱附近）被特尔维尔可汗的军队伏击并击败。查士丁尼二世逃回君士坦丁堡，保加利亚巩固了对扎戈拉地区的控制。这是三次安基阿卢斯战役中的第一次，此后双方在巴尔干维持了数十年的相对和平。
entries.summaryEn: In 708 the Byzantine emperor Justinian II invaded Bulgaria and was ambushed and defeated at Anchialus, near modern Pomorie, by the forces of Khan Tervel. Justinian escaped to Constantinople while Bulgaria consolidated control of the Zagora region. It was the first of three battles fought there.
entries.significanceZh: 安基阿卢斯之战稳固了保加利亚对巴尔干东部山地的控制，也削弱了查士丁尼二世的威望。
entries.significanceEn: Anchialus secured Bulgarian control of the eastern Balkan mountains and weakened Justinian II's standing.
entries.notesZh: 安基阿卢斯一名对应708年、763年与917年三次战事，本条专指708年之战，只保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: Three battles are called Anchialus, in 708, 763 and 917; this entry is the 708 battle and keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 1281年10月29日，伊儿汗国军队在阿八哈汗之弟蒙哥帖木儿率领下进攻叙利亚，与嘉拉温苏丹的马木留克军队在霍姆斯附近会战。蒙古军一度击破马木留克左翼，但其右翼被击溃、主将受伤后撤，全军退兵。伊儿汗国夺取叙利亚的企图再次失败。
entries.summaryEn: On 29 October 1281 an Ilkhanate army under Möngke Temür, brother of Abaqa Khan, invaded Syria and met the Mamluks of Sultan Qalawun near Homs. The Mongols broke the Mamluk left but their own right collapsed and their commander withdrew wounded, ending the campaign. The Ilkhanate again failed to take Syria.
entries.significanceZh: 第二次霍姆斯之战使马木留克王朝保住叙利亚，伊儿汗国的西进至此长期停滞。
entries.significanceEn: The second battle of Homs kept Syria in Mamluk hands and checked the Ilkhanate's westward expansion for a generation.
entries.notesZh: 双方兵力（伊儿汗国约五万、马木留克数目不详）出自不同史料，亚美尼亚与格鲁吉亚盟军数字亦不一致；本条只保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: The Mongol force is usually put at about 50,000 while Mamluk numbers are unrecorded, and figures for the Armenian and Georgian contingents also differ; this entry keeps year precision.
